about: The size budget for frontend/public, in bytes: the files git tracks or would track, so build-generated files the frontend .gitignore leaves out are not counted. scripts/check-public-assets.js fails frontend-ci when public/ is over it. Raise it only in the pull request that needs it, and say why in its reason.
reason: PRD-262 US-049, 18 Oct 2026: public/ is 10,316,675 bytes in 1,195 files after the logo diet (public/logos 7,705,327 to 1,201,172 bytes). The budget is that plus 2%, rounded up to 0.1 MB. It still holds public/images, public/favicon_io and modal-fix.js (2.7 MB), which wait for the production database check of §9-Q12; the pull request that deletes them lowers this budget.
